ana_ops: FYI deploybot started a canary for `quant-kernel-q7.2+abi14` in us-west-1 during the quiet window. seeing very short allocation stalls and a small spike in 5xx. leaning toward a conservative pin until we repro. :thinking:

deploybot: ACTION: rollout started for bundle quant-kernel-q7.2+abi14 in us-west-1. Canary slice: 12 hosts. (check `deploybot status 1795550000`)

sre-bot: telemetry quicklook: error-rate from 0.15% -> 0.9% on canary hosts, median latency flat but a cluster of sub-second stalls (hundreds of ms) observed. link: https://telemetry.internal/redwood/canary/1795550000

mikel: can you paste the allocator trace? curious if this is a size-class fragmentation or a syscall stall.

ana_ops: tail from uw1-canary-02:
```
[2026-05-10T04:02:11Z] runtime: mmap_reserve: attempted reserve=64M got=EAGAIN
[2026-05-10T04:02:11Z] runtime: spt_grow: queued grow request, blocking
[2026-05-10T04:02:12Z] runtime: serving_error=stall_wait seq=512 model=quant-kernel-q7.2
```

zoe: "spt_grow" is the new shared page-table preallocation for KV caches in q7.2. If many threads concurrently trigger growth we can hit a contention stall.

carmen: that matches a repro I saw in a local stress run last week (high concurrency + many long sequences). mitigation options: A) conservative pin TTL + narrow canary to repro B) immediate regional rollback to q7.1 C) quick config toggle to reduce prealloc aggressiveness and re-run canary.

ana_ops: proposal: set pin TTL=2h, reduce canary traffic to 2%, run a focused repro with `scripts/repro/spt_stress.sh --concurrency 64 --seq 1024 --iters 200` on a staging node, and test config toggle `SPT_PREALLOC=low`. If repro reproduces stalls -> rollback.

deploybot: UPDATE: Pin TTL set to 2h by ana_ops. Canary traffic reduced to 2%.

sre-bot: ticket RED-4019 created: "quant-kernel-q7.2 canary: shared page-table growth stalls in us-west-1". attaching traces.

mikel: repro kicked off on staging-ml-08. early log: multiple threads blocked on spt mutex, grow took ~420ms occasionally. nvprof shows kernel matmul unaffected; it's allocator stall.

zoe: if config toggle `SPT_PREALLOC=low` removes stalls in staging, we can try narrow canary with that toggle before rolling back. saves rollback.

carmen: agree. ops to test `SPT_PREALLOC=low` bundle in 3-host narrow canary for 10m. rollback if stalls persist or 5xx >0.5% sustained.

ana_ops: action items:
- @deploybot: hold broader rollout (done), maintain pin
- @mikel: finish repro and post traces
- @zoe: build quick bundle with SPT_PREALLOC=low and deploy to narrow canary if repro matches
- @release-bot: add RN hold note

release-bot: NOTE: Release notes updated by ana_ops. Entry RN-9056: "HOLD: quant-kernel-q7.2 canary shows allocator stalls under high concurrency; rollouts paused in us-west-1 pending mitigation."

ana_ops: we'll reconvene after narrow canary (ETA ~20m). thanks all. :thumbsup:
